reviews.review:
This is a great game! Got all of the achievements in 219h on record but they can be done a lot faster.

I will do some pros and cons for the game

PROS
-Good graphics
-Not too bad story
-Great bosses
-Great voice acting
-A campaign that has some good twists and turns
-Lots and lots of gore
-Awesome character models
-Lots of weapons to choose from in the campaign and in Multiplayer
-Singleplayer has no graphical bugs or game-breaking bugs
-Community is alive
-Multiplayer is barely alive
-Decent color schemes and armor types for Space Marines and Chaos
-Lots of Perks to choose from, you can try different combinations so you can find out which ones are the best for your style of gameplay

CONS
-Multiplayer is bugged
-Clans dominate the Multiplayer scene and therefore tend to make people leave the game
-Some weapons in Multiplayer are overpowered
-Multiplayer is set on a P2P connection and it's sometimes really unstable since it is always trying to find a better host even though the original host was better
-Multiplayer is not protected by VAC

I recommend it. 8/10 would serve with 203rd again!

8 years later this is still holds it's own. The aesthetics have been nailed, the combat flow is weighty and satisfying, the weapons are varied and feel like the monsters they are meant to be, all round a really decent action game. Sales often drop the price to sub-10, at which point it's a steal.

I think the game is amazing, my only problem is until recently, it hasn't been letting me play the game, and just keeps closing as soon as it starts up, if anyone know how to fix this, please tell me, but, besides that, it is an amazing game from the Warhammer40k franchise.
Fun and straightforward game that has nice Lore.

One of the most satisfying melee combat feels ever. 

Though my brother Alpharius wouldn't tell you that.

(Bring back more people playing multiplayer!)
